```{r}
# ---- Tool naming & aesthetics -------------------------------------------
# Canonical base-tool order and a palette matching the manuscript charts.
tool_levels  <- c("esviritu", "centrifuger", "kraken2", "metabuli", "sylph")
tool_labels  <- c(esviritu = "EsViritu", centrifuger = "Centrifuger",
                  kraken2 = "Kraken2", metabuli = "Metabuli", sylph = "Sylph")
tool_palette <- c(esviritu = "#90D4CC", centrifuger = "#FBA72A",
                  kraken2 = "#D3D4D8", metabuli = "#CB7A5C", sylph = "#5785C1")

# Headline parameter-set selection: pick the BEST parameter set per competitor
# so comparisons are not vulnerable to a "you crippled the competitor" critique.
# Set to "manual" and edit headline_params_manual to fix specific sets instead.
HEADLINE_PARAM_MODE <- "best"   # "best" or "manual"
headline_params_manual <- c(
  esviritu    = "sense",
  centrifuger = "mhl100_ms0",
  kraken2     = "conf0_mhg2",
  metabuli    = "prec0_ms0_ptaxnone",
  sylph       = "mnk20"
)
```


Functions
```{r}

# Split a combined "tool_param" string (positive-control style) into base tool
# + parameter set. Clean names (mock tables) pass through unchanged.
split_tool <- function(x) {
  base <- str_extract(x, paste(tool_levels, collapse = "|"))
  base <- coalesce(base, x)
  param <- str_remove(x, paste0("^", base, "_?"))
  param <- if_else(param == "", "default", param)
  tibble(base_tool = base, param_set = param)
}

# Standardise a base-tool column to an ordered factor with nice labels.
factor_tool <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(str_extract(x, regex(paste(tool_levels, collapse = "|"),
                                    ignore_case = TRUE)))
  factor(x, levels = tool_levels, labels = tool_labels[tool_levels])
}

# Choose one parameter set per base tool for headline (paired) comparisons.
# `score_col` is the column used to rank param sets when mode == "best"
# (higher = better). Returns the input filtered to one param set per tool.
pick_headline <- function(df, tool_col = "base_tool",
                          param_col = "param_set", score_col) {
  if (HEADLINE_PARAM_MODE == "manual") {
    keep <- tibble(base_tool = names(headline_params_manual),
                   param_set = unname(headline_params_manual))
    df |>
      inner_join(keep, by = setNames(c("base_tool", "param_set"),
                                     c(tool_col, param_col)))
  } else {
    best <- df |>
      group_by(.data[[tool_col]], .data[[param_col]]) |>
      summarise(.score = mean(.data[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop_last") |>
      slice_max(.score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
      ungroup() |>
      select(all_of(c(tool_col, param_col)))
    df |> inner_join(best, by = c(tool_col, param_col))
  }
}

# ---- Plotting -----------------------------------------------------------
theme_bench <- function() {
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "bottom")
}

save_fig <- function(plot, name, w = 8, h = 5) {
  ggsave(file.path(paths$out_fig, name), plot, width = w, height = h)
  message("wrote ", file.path(paths$out_fig, name))
}

save_tab <- function(df, name) {
  readr::write_csv(df, file.path(paths$out_tab, name))
  message("wrote ", file.path(paths$out_tab, name))
}
```

```{r}
# 01_positive_control_glmm.R ---------------------------------------------
# Mixed-effects logistic regression of detection in the positive control,
# with genome (accession) as a random effect to avoid pseudoreplication
# across permutations. Produces tool contrasts and a limit-of-detection
# (LD50) per tool.
READS_REF <- 2   # log10(read pairs) centring reference => 100 read pairs

pos_raw <- read_csv(paths$pos, show_col_types = FALSE)
pos_raw <- pos_raw |>
  bind_cols(split_tool(pos_raw$tool)) |>
  mutate(
    base_tool = factor_tool(base_tool),
    log_reads = log10(read_count),
    lr_c      = log_reads - READS_REF,
    ANI       = bestANI,
    accession = factor(accession),
    detected  = as.integer(detected)
  )

# Headline set: one (best) parameter set per tool, ranked by mean detection.
pos <- pos_raw |>
  mutate(base_tool = as.character(base_tool)) |>
  pick_headline(score_col = "detected") |>
  mutate(base_tool = relevel(factor(base_tool, levels = tool_labels[tool_levels]),
                             ref = tool_labels[["esviritu"]]))

message("Headline parameter sets used:")
pos |> distinct(base_tool, param_set) |> arrange(base_tool) |> print()

```

```{r}

# ---- Primary model: Firth logistic, tool x depth, genome blocked --------
m <- glm(detected ~ base_tool * lr_c + accession,
         data = pos, family = binomial, method = brglmFit)
stopifnot(m$converged, m$rank == length(coef(m)))   # full rank, converged
print(summary(m))
save_tab(tidy(m) |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 4))),
         "pos_firth_coefficients.csv")
```

```{r}

# ---- Pairwise tool contrasts (EsViritu vs each), BH-corrected -----------
# Averaged over genomes (nuisance) at representative depths.
emm <- emmeans(m, ~ base_tool, at = list(lr_c = log10(c(10, 100)) - READS_REF),
               nuisance = "accession", type = "response")
contr <- contrast(emm, "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1, adjust = "BH") |> as_tibble()
print(contr)
save_tab(as_tibble(emm), "pos_firth_emmeans.csv")
save_tab(contr, "pos_firth_tool_contrasts.csv")

```

```{r}

# ---- Pooled detection-vs-depth curves (population-average over genomes) -
curve <- emmeans(m, ~ base_tool, by = "lr_c",
                 at = list(lr_c = seq(0, 3, 0.05) - READS_REF),
                 nuisance = "accession", type = "response") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(read_pairs = 10^(lr_c + READS_REF))

p_curve <- curve |>
  ggplot(aes(read_pairs, prob, colour = base_tool, fill = base_tool)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(tool_palette[tool_levels]),
                      aesthetics = c("colour", "fill")) +
  labs(x = "Read pairs (input)", y = "Detection probability (avg over genomes)",
       colour = "Tool", fill = "Tool",
       title = "Positive control: modelled detection vs depth") +
  theme_bench()
save_fig(p_curve, "pos_detection_curves.pdf", w = 7, h = 4.5)

```

```{r}

# ---- LD50 per tool per genome, vs ANI (divergence story) ----------------
cross_50 <- function(x, p) {              # interpolate x where p crosses 0.5
  if (all(p < 0.5)) return(NA_real_)
  if (all(p >= 0.5)) return(min(x))
  i <- which(p >= 0.5)[1]
  if (i == 1) return(x[1])
  x[i - 1] + (0.5 - p[i - 1]) * (x[i] - x[i - 1]) / (p[i] - p[i - 1])
}

depth_grid <- tibble(lr_c = seq(0, 3, 0.01) - READS_REF)

ld50 <- pos |>
  group_by(accession, ANI) |>
  group_modify(~{
    fit <- glm(detected ~ base_tool * lr_c, data = .x,
               family = binomial, method = brglmFit)
    expand_grid(base_tool = levels(.x$base_tool), depth_grid) |>
      mutate(base_tool = factor(base_tool, levels = levels(.x$base_tool)),
             prob = predict(fit, newdata = pick(everything()), type = "response")) |>
      arrange(base_tool, lr_c) |>
      group_by(base_tool) |>
      summarise(ld50_reads = 10^(cross_50(lr_c, prob) + READS_REF), .groups = "drop")
  }) |>
  ungroup()
save_tab(ld50, "pos_ld50_per_genome.csv")
print(ld50 |> arrange(base_tool, ANI), n = Inf)
```

```{r}

p_ld50 <- ld50 |>
  ggplot(aes(ANI, ld50_reads, colour = base_tool, group = base_tool)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  # NA LD50 = never reached 50% detection at any depth: mark at the ceiling
  geom_point(data = ld50 |> filter(is.na(ld50_reads)) |> mutate(ld50_reads = 2000),
             shape = 4, size = 2.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(tool_palette[tool_levels]), name = "Tool") +
  labs(x = "Genome ANI to reference (%)",
       y = "LD50: read pairs for 50% detection (log)",
       title = "Limit of detection vs divergence",
       caption = "x = never reached 50% detection at any tested depth") +
  theme_bench()
save_fig(p_ld50, "pos_ld50_vs_ani.pdf", w = 7, h = 4.5)
```

False Postives in Neg Controls
```{r}

# Negative-control specificity. Paired across tools per sample (small n =>
# non-parametric). Friedman + post-hoc Wilcoxon (BH) on FP read % and on the
# number of false species, plus Kendall's W effect size.


# The negative-control table holds the full parameter sweep (many settings per
# tool) and both EsViritu modes. Collapse to ONE best-case value per
# (sample, base_tool): the minimum false-positive load across that tool's
# settings/modes. This (a) reports each tool at its best specificity and
# (b) guarantees an unreplicated complete block design for Friedman.
neg <- read_csv(paths$neg, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    base_tool = factor_tool(tool),
    neg_class = "true_negative"
    ) |>
  group_by(neg_class, sample, base_tool) |>
  summarise(fp_pct = min(fp_pct), n_species = min(n_species),
            .groups = "drop")

sample_info <- tibble(
  sample = c("SRR32674837", "SRR38307491", "SRR38270014", "SRR38629931", "SRR38746368", "chm13v2_10M", "SRR31273449"),
  sample_source = c("hot springs", "soil", "freshwater", "anaerobic digester", "mouse RNA", "human genome synthetic reads", "marine water")
)

neg <- merge(
  neg,
  sample_info,
  by = "sample"
)
```

```{r}

run_friedman_block <- function(df, value, label) {
  value <- as.character(ensym(value))      # column name as a string
  # complete blocks only
  ok <- df |> count(sample, base_tool) |> count(sample) |>
    filter(n == n_distinct(df$base_tool)) |> pull(sample)
  df <- df |> filter(sample %in% ok)
  if (n_distinct(df$sample) < 2) {
    message("  (", label, ": <2 complete blocks, skipping Friedman)")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  f <- as.formula(paste0(value, " ~ base_tool | sample"))
  fr <- friedman_test(df, f)
  w  <- friedman_effsize(df, f)
  ph <- df |>
    wilcox_test(reformulate("base_tool", value),
                paired = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "BH") |>
    add_significance()
  save_tab(as_tibble(fr), paste0("neg_", label, "_friedman.csv"))
  save_tab(as_tibble(w),  paste0("neg_", label, "_kendallW.csv"))
  save_tab(as_tibble(ph), paste0("neg_", label, "_posthoc.csv"))
  print(fr); print(w)
  invisible(ph)
}

for (cls in unique(neg$neg_class)) {
  message("== ", cls, " ==")
  d <- neg |> filter(neg_class == cls)
  run_friedman_block(d, fp_pct,   paste0(cls, "_fp_pct"))
  run_friedman_block(d, n_species, paste0(cls, "_n_species"))
}
```

```{r}

rank_m <- read_csv(paths$rank, show_col_types = FALSE)  # tab-sep? -> handle both
if (ncol(rank_m) == 1) rank_m <- read_tsv(paths$rank, show_col_types = FALSE)

mock <- rank_m |>
  mutate(base_tool = as.character(factor_tool(tool))) |>
  pick_headline(score_col = "F1") |>
  mutate(
    base_tool = relevel(factor(base_tool, levels = tool_labels[tool_levels]),
                        ref = tool_labels[["esviritu"]]),
    rank = factor(rank, levels = c("family", "genus", "species")),
    sample = factor(sample)
  )

mock |> distinct(base_tool, param_set) |> arrange(base_tool) |> print()

```


```{r}

fit_metric <- function(df, metric) {
  f <- reformulate(c("base_tool * rank", "sample"), response = metric)
  m <- lm(f, data = df)
  emm <- emmeans(m, ~ base_tool | rank)   # averages over the sample blocks
  contr <- contrast(emm, "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1, adjust = "BH") |>
    as_tibble() |> mutate(metric = metric)
  list(model = m,
       emmeans = as_tibble(emm) |> mutate(metric = metric),
       contrasts = contr)
}

metrics <- c("F1", "bray_curtis_rel", "pearson")
res <- map(set_names(metrics), ~ fit_metric(mock, .x))

emm_all  <- map_dfr(res, "emmeans")
con_all  <- map_dfr(res, "contrasts")
save_tab(emm_all, "mock_lmm_emmeans.csv")
save_tab(con_all, "mock_lmm_contrasts.csv")
print(con_all, n = Inf)
```

Abundance Calibration
```{r}

g_all <- read_tsv(paths$genome, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(base_tool = as.character(factor_tool(tool)),
         detected  = as.logical(detected))

# Headline param set per tool by mean detection of truth taxa (full data,
# before subsetting to detected taxa).
g <- g_all |>
  pick_headline(score_col = "detected") |>
  filter(detected, read_count > 0, assigned_reads > 0) |>   # detected truth taxa
  mutate(true_log = log10(read_count),
         pred_log = log10(assigned_reads))

# Calibration stats for one set of (true_log, pred_log) points.
calib_stats <- function(d) {
  ok <- nrow(d) >= 3 && var(d$true_log) > 0 && var(d$pred_log) > 0
  cc <- if (ok) tryCatch(DescTools::CCC(d$true_log, d$pred_log)$rho.c,
                         error = function(e)
                           data.frame(est = NA, lwr.ci = NA, upr.ci = NA))
        else data.frame(est = NA, lwr.ci = NA, upr.ci = NA)
  fit <- if (ok) lm(pred_log ~ true_log, data = d) else NULL
  tibble(
    n         = nrow(d),
    slope     = if (ok) coef(fit)[["true_log"]] else NA_real_,
    intercept = if (ok) coef(fit)[["(Intercept)"]] else NA_real_,
    r2        = if (ok) summary(fit)$r.squared else NA_real_,
    pearson   = if (ok) cor(d$true_log, d$pred_log) else NA_real_,
    ccc       = cc$est, ccc_lo = cc$lwr.ci, ccc_hi = cc$upr.ci
  )
}

g_strata <- bind_rows(
  g |> mutate(stratum = "pooled"),
  g |> filter(ani_level >= 95, n_truth_sharing_clade == 1) |>
    mutate(stratum = "resolvable")
)

calib <- g_strata |>
  group_by(stratum, base_tool) |>
  group_modify(~ calib_stats(.x)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(base_tool = factor(base_tool, levels = tool_labels[tool_levels]),
         stratum   = factor(stratum, levels = c("pooled", "resolvable")))
print(calib)
save_tab(calib, "abundance_calibration.csv")
```

```{r}
p_scatter <- g |>

  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = resolvable), alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8,
              aes(colour = "all (pooled)")) +
  geom_smooth(data = ~ filter(.x, resolvable), method = "lm", se = FALSE,
              linewidth = 0.8, aes(colour = "resolvable")) +
  facet_wrap(~ base_tool) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("all (pooled)" = "grey40",
                                 "resolvable" = "#2c7fb8",
                                 "TRUE" = "#2c7fb8", "FALSE" = "grey70"),
                      breaks = c("all (pooled)", "resolvable"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "log10 true reads", y = "log10 predicted reads",
       title = "Abundance calibration (dashed = perfect agreement)",
       subtitle = "lines: pooled vs resolvable (ANI>=95, single-clade)") +
  theme_bench()
save_fig(p_scatter, "abundance_calibration_scatter.pdf", w = 8.5, h = 6)
```

Capping vs Strict Taxonomy for Divergent Genomes
```{r}
unified_path <- file.path(here::here("data/mock_virome/unified_long.tsv"))
gt_files <- list.files(file.path(here::here("data/mock_virome")),
                       pattern = "ground_truth.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}

ranks <- c("family", "genus", "species", "subspecies")

# ANI (% identity to reference) -> deepest resolvable rank for capped mode.
ANI_RANK_CAP <- tribble(
  ~ani_level, ~cap_rank,
  100,        "subspecies",
  98,         "subspecies",
  95,         "species",
  90,         "species",
  85,         "genus",
  80,         "genus"
)
rank_order <- c(family = 1, genus = 2, species = 3, subspecies = 4)

# ---- Helpers ------------------------------------------------------------
# Treat NA / "" / bare prefix ("g__", "t__") as unclassified at that rank.
clean_label <- function(x) {
  x <- na_if(str_squish(replace_na(as.character(x), "")), "")
  if_else(is.na(x) | str_detect(x, "_{2}\\s*$"), NA_character_, x)
}

# One profile (taxon, rel) per rank vs one truth (taxon, rel): all metrics.
score_pair <- function(pred, truth) {
  j <- full_join(pred, truth, by = "taxon",
                 suffix = c("_p", "_t")) |>
    mutate(rel_p = replace_na(rel_p, 0), rel_t = replace_na(rel_t, 0))
  tp <- sum(j$rel_p > 0 & j$rel_t > 0)
  fp <- sum(j$rel_p > 0 & j$rel_t == 0)
  fn <- sum(j$rel_p == 0 & j$rel_t > 0)
  prec <- if (tp + fp > 0) tp / (tp + fp) else NA_real_
  rec  <- if (tp + fn > 0) tp / (tp + fn) else NA_real_
  bc   <- if (sum(j$rel_p + j$rel_t) > 0)
            sum(abs(j$rel_p - j$rel_t)) / sum(j$rel_p + j$rel_t) else NA_real_
  pear <- if (sd(j$rel_p) > 0 && sd(j$rel_t) > 0) cor(j$rel_p, j$rel_t) else NA_real_
  spear<- if (sd(j$rel_p) > 0 && sd(j$rel_t) > 0)
            cor(j$rel_p, j$rel_t, method = "spearman") else NA_real_
  tibble(n_pred = tp + fp, n_truth = tp + fn, TP = tp, FP = fp, FN = fn,
         precision = prec, recall = rec,
         F1 = if (!is.na(prec) && !is.na(rec) && prec + rec > 0)
                2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec) else NA_real_,
         bray_curtis = bc, pearson = pear, spearman = spear)
}
```


```{r}
# ---- Load + normalise predicted profiles --------------------------------
u <- read_tsv(unified_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(ranks), clean_label),
         base_tool = factor_tool(tool)) |>
  group_by(tool, param_set, sample) |>           # one unit per profile -> rel
  mutate(rel = count / sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup()

# ---- Load ground truth (per community), build strict + capped versions --
gt <- map_dfr(gt_files, ~ read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
                #gsub("\\..*", "", filename)
                mutate(sample = str_extract(basename(.x), "[a-z_]+\\d+"))) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(ranks), clean_label),
         rel = read_count / sum(read_count), .by = sample) |>
  left_join(ANI_RANK_CAP, by = "ani_level")

# ---- Compute metrics per (tool, param_set, sample, rank, mode) ----------
metrics <- map_dfr(ranks, function(rk) {
  pred_rk <- u |>
    mutate(taxon = .data[[rk]]) |>
    filter(!is.na(taxon)) |>
    summarise(rel = sum(rel),
              .by = c(base_tool, tool, param_set, sample, taxon))
  map_dfr(c("strict", "capped"), function(mode) {
    truth_rk <- gt |>
      { \(d) if (mode == "capped")
               filter(d, rank_order[cap_rank] >= rank_order[[rk]]) else d }() |>
      mutate(taxon = .data[[rk]]) |>
      filter(!is.na(taxon)) |>
      summarise(rel = sum(rel), .by = c(sample, taxon))

    pred_rk |>
      group_by(base_tool, tool, param_set, sample) |>
      group_modify(~ score_pair(
        select(.x, taxon, rel),
        filter(truth_rk, sample == .y$sample) |> select(taxon, rel))) |>
      ungroup() |>
      mutate(rank = rk, truth_mode = mode)
  })
})

metrics <- metrics |>
  mutate(rank = factor(rank, levels = ranks),
         base_tool = factor(base_tool, levels = tool_labels[tool_levels]))
save_tab(metrics, "profile_vs_truth_metrics.csv")
message("rows: ", nrow(metrics))
```

```{r}
# ---- Headline summary: best param set per tool (by F1, strict) ----------
headline <- metrics |>
  filter(truth_mode == "strict") |>
  summarise(mF1 = mean(F1, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(base_tool, tool, param_set)) |>
  slice_max(mF1, n = 1, by = base_tool, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  select(base_tool, tool, param_set)

summary_tbl <- metrics |>
  inner_join(headline, by = c("base_tool", "tool", "param_set")) |>
  summarise(across(c(F1, bray_curtis, pearson),
                   ~ round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 3)),
            .by = c(base_tool, rank, truth_mode)) |>
  arrange(rank, truth_mode, base_tool)
save_tab(summary_tbl, "profile_vs_truth_summary.csv")
print(summary_tbl, n = Inf)
```
